items.name: Lambda Upgrader
items.label: LAMBDA
items.description:
each time an ore is upgraded there is a 1 - 1.5 / upgrade Count chance to destroy the ore. 

If it survives it has a 1/19  chance to multiply by 3.52, 1/19 chance to add 1,100, 1/19 to create an explosion, 1/19 chance to set the ore value to 1, 1/19 chance to fling your ore and multiply by 2.42, 1/19 chance to multiply by 6.6 and apply sparkle effect to the ore, and a 13/19 chance to multiply by 2.42.

Total survival Chance= 1.5^(n-1) / n! · Obtained from toxic crate
